```{r}
# install.packages("ipumsr")

# load pkg & read in ipums data
library(ipumsr)
ddi <- read_ipums_ddi("usa_00001.xml")
ipums_data <- read_ipums_micro(ddi)

# save as compressed .rdata file
save(ipums_data, file = "ipums_data.RData", compress = "xz")
```
